entries.title: Aquatico

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Aquatico is an underwater survival city-builder released for Windows on January 12, 2023, with an official Founder's Pack add-on. The Founder's Bundle is the base game plus soundtrack and Founder's Pack, with no console, Mac, or Linux release found. Windows PC is the definitive archive route because it is the only release platform and the only current gameplay route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. The Founder's Pack and soundtrack are optional extras, not required gameplay content.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Steam achievements and cloud support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced gameplay platform in this pass; no platform-exclusive content split was found.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content or remaster split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive-edition split was found. The Founder's Pack is not required for gameplay completeness.
